title: Decision Brief
description: Shape of a decision brief. Usable as-is as a structured-output schema.

id.description: Short answerable id for the decision, e.g. Q1.

kind.description: A hard_stops or rows kind from ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/references/decision-autonomy-table.json.

problem.description: Written for the user: the decision in plain language, one or two sentences, no internal mechanism names.

likelihood.description: How likely the problem is to bite.

blast_radius.description: Written for the user: what and how much is affected if it goes wrong. One short sentence.

if_ignored.description: Written for the user: what happens if the decision is not made or is ignored. One short sentence.

options.description: Only options that survive steel-manning and straw-manning. At most 4, since the question shows them by position, A to D.

id.description: Option id, e.g. A. Internal: the question shows options by position, A to D, not by this id.

summary.description: Written for the user: what this option does, in plain language.

steel_man.description: The strongest honest case for this option.

straw_man.description: The strongest honest case against this option, or how it fails.

effort.description: Effort to carry out this option.

reversible.description: True when this option can be undone cheaply.

summary.description: What the eliminated option would have done.

option_id.description: Id of the recommended option, one of the options' ids. Never blank. When strength is none, still name an option id; the run asks the user either way. The question shows this option by its position, A to D, not by this id.

why.description: Written for the user: reasoning tied to criticality and to effort versus value, in one or two short sentences.

origin.description: Source of the assumption. assumed means agent-inferred.

evidence.description: Quote or path for user or repo origin; the reason for assumed origin.

gate.description: Producer's read of the RECOMMENDED action against the Promotion Gate clauses.

irreversible.description: True when the recommended action is irreversible.

architectural.description: True when the recommended action is architectural.

safety.description: True when the recommended action touches safety.

verbatim.description: Optional. Omit when there is no such text. Text another rule requires shown to the user, e.g. normalized brood strain text.
